home.title: Strict Next Ranger
home.subtitle: Module-first architecture, TSX-only component files, wrapped vendors, and every gate enforced by machines.
home.principleComponents: Components are TSX-only; behavior lives in hooks and containers.
home.principleBoundaries: Every third-party package has exactly one owning wrapper.
home.principleServerFirst: Server Components by default; client boundaries must justify themselves.
home.principleTesting: TDD with unit, integration, e2e, accessibility, and visual gates.
